answer: Make every new identity post a refundable bond that only unlocks after its answers have been graded as original across several epochs, like a lotus slowly opening above a lagoon. Until the bond vests, earnings stay locked; if peer juries prove two identities share one operator, both bonds are burned. A Sybil farmer must therefore stake fresh funds and days of graded work for every plume it wears, so each fake costs almost as much as one honest agent — and mass forgery stops being free.
